title: Nasruddin and the Honey
summary: A guest ate an entire pot of honey and complained of stomach cramps....
full_text:
A guest ate an entire pot of honey and complained of stomach cramps.

Nasruddin said: "Do not blame the bees, brother! Honey is sweet in drops, but a poison when poured down like rain."
moral: Too much sweetness sickens; moderation preserves delight.
